records.title: Olaparib
records.abstract: Olaparib is a small molecule inhibitor of poly ADP-ribose polymerase and is used as an antineoplastic agent in the therapy of refractory and advanced ovarian carcinoma. Olaparib therapy is associated with a low rate of transient elevations in serum aminotransferase during therapy and has been linked to several instances of clinically apparent liver injury which can be severe and even fatal.
records.journal: LiverTox: Clinical and Research Information on Drug-Induced Liver Injury
